name: Arundo
look_here_first: Start with cane-like jointed culms from thick rhizomes, broad flat leaves, and the large terminal panicle. Inspect the ligule and mature spikelets to separate it from Phragmites; height alone is not a reliable key.

project_scope.note: First-pass source-pool learner anchors; unresolved range and comparison labels retained.

genus_diagnostics.habit: Dense stands of tall cane-like stems; selected photograph shows a stand in Maui, not a Texas locality.
genus_diagnostics.leaves: Broad flat grass blades on conspicuous culms; sheath and ligule require close photographs.
genus_diagnostics.inflorescence: Large terminal panicle; panicle architecture and spikelet detail remain photo gaps.
genus_diagnostics.lookalike_separators: Phragmites australis overlaps in tall reed habit; inspect ligule and mature spikelet/flower characters. Native and introduced Phragmites lineages need their own treatment; do not infer lineage or taxon from height or a distant stand photograph.

study_strategy.warning: Provisional one-photo coverage per species. Specific missing anatomy is shown as needs-photo; no arrows verified.
